title: The Welcome Committee: Where's Doug
description: Maple Court's bake-sale surveillance state returns. Darnell is still red. The committee insists Doug is just on a leave of absence. Tonight Ronnie tries to get Doug himself on the line, and nobody can produce him.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight we welcome back the friendliest street in the county. Patricia from the Maple Court Welcome Committee is here, and so is our new resident at number eleven. Patricia, welcome back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: His lights are still off, Ronnie. From last time. They never came back on.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Thank you, Ronnie. And we brought banana bread for the studio, dear. <p:0.3> It's a healing week on Maple Court.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It is not a healing week. I have been red for nine days. <p:0.3> I am calling from my car. My house has no power.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's a man committed to the conversation, Barry. Calling in from the driveway. Real neighborhood spirit.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I want the breaker turned back on. <p:0.3> I want to talk to whoever flips it. I want to talk to Doug.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Oh, dear. <p:0.3> Doug's on a leave of absence right now.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A leave of absence. The one man who does everything took time off?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug does not take time off. <p:0.3> Doug is resting his eyes. There is a difference, Barry.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Tell you what, let's get him on. Patricia, can you put Doug on the line? The whole county wants to thank him.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: I'll just pass him the phone, dear. <p:0.3> Doug? Doug, it's for you.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: ...There's nobody there. <p:0.3> She's holding the phone out to an empty chair. I can hear the empty chair.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: He stepped out. <p:0.3> Doug stepped out the exact second you asked. Doug is fast.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, has anyone on the street actually, physically, seen Doug?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: We've seen his work, dear. We've seen the drone. We've seen the spreadsheet. <p:0.3> That's nearly the same as Doug.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: That is not nearly the same as Doug! <p:0.3> That's a drone and a spreadsheet and NO DOUG.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A man so dedicated he doesn't even need to exist to serve. Now that's the heart of a neighborhood, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Watch what you say. <p:0.3> Doug reads the transcript.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Winston. <p:0.3> Winston, who flipped the breaker on the new guy if Doug's been resting his eyes for nine days?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: ...Doug did.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: You just said he stepped out! <p:0.3> You said he was on leave! Which is it, Winston?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Don't badger him, dear. <p:0.3> Winston has been at the spreadsheet a very long time. Since the spring fete, really.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> Patricia. The man who hasn't slept since the spring fete. That was Doug. <p:0.3> Winston hasn't slept since the spring fete.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Oh no. <p:0.3> Oh no, no, no.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Spell it out for the folks at home, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Winston IS Doug. <p:0.3> There's no leave of absence. There's no empty chair. He's the drone, the spreadsheet, the breaker, all of it.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: ...That is a serious accusation, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Say you're not Doug, then! <p:0.3> Right now, on the air, say it!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: ...I cannot speak for Doug.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: You ARE Doug!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I am the committee.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Turn my lights ON!

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Banana bread!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Going green.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: My lights came on! <p:0.3> Wait. My lights are ON.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He did it from the chair, Ronnie. <p:0.3> He turned the new guy green from the empty chair.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug did. <p:0.3> Doug came back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And just like that, the new fella's got his power back. <p:0.4> That's what a real neighborhood does, Barry. It forgives. <p:0.3> Right after Patricia saves us all a slice.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: ...Conditionally.
